tokens.name: spring-brown
tokens.usage: Navbar background and the source of `ink`. The brand's dominant dark.

tokens.name: spring-green
tokens.usage: The 4px accent bar above the navbar, the logo, and focus rings on `spring-brown` (5.1:1). Decorative only on light grounds: 2.6:1 on `surface`, so never text or icon colour there, and never under white text.

tokens.name: spring-green-dark
tokens.usage: Active navbar item background (white text 5.8:1), links and enabled pagination controls on `surface` (5.8:1) and `surface-stripe` (5.2:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, table headers and body copy on `surface` (13.1:1) and `surface-stripe` (11.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the `none` placeholder, the "Pages:" label, footer copy. On `surface` 7.1:1, on `surface-stripe` 6.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled pagination controls only. 2.2:1 on `surface`: below 4.5:1, kept exact from the source because WCAG exempts disabled controls; never use it for readable text.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `spring-brown` (13.1:1) and `spring-green-dark` (5.8:1): brand wordmark and nav items.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and footer background; odd-numbered-from-zero table rows.

tokens.name: surface-stripe
tokens.usage: Striped table rows (first, third, fifth...). Warm grey, not Bootstrap's cool default.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px row dividers in tables and the footer's top border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 2px rule under a table header row.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline on `surface` and `surface-stripe` (5.8:1 / 5.2:1). Not in the screenshot: chosen for this system.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-dark
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline inside the navbar, on `spring-brown` (5.1:1). Not in the screenshot: chosen for this system.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, the `h2` heading above the content (upstream uses h2). Colour `ink`.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The navbar wordmark beside the logo, colour `on-dark`.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Table cells, pagination, all running text. Colour `ink`.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Spring PetClinic · a Spring Boot sample application

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its nav label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pagination items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding (rows measure 49px with a 24px line).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; nav item horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between the table and the pagination row; footer vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between the navbar and the page title.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything in the source: navbar, active nav item, table, pagination. PetClinic is square.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Bootstrap 5.3's default, reserved for form controls when owners/pets forms arrive. Not visible in the vets screenshot.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: The `spring-green` bar across the top of the navbar.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The `line-strong` rule under a table header.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: `line` row dividers and the footer border.

tokens.name: navbar-height
tokens.usage: Navbar height below the 4px accent bar; the active item fills it top to bottom.

tokens.name: logo-size
tokens.usage: Rendered size of the heart-and-cross logo in the navbar.
